findings_addressed.oracle: Two independent oracles: (1) count oracle — len(evidence) must equal len([act for act in network_activity if act['remote_port'] == _C2_PORT]) computed before match_behaviors is called; (2) loopback oracle — all evidence strings must contain 'to 127.0.0.1' because every self-generated connection targets the loopback interface. Both fail under the mutation activity['remote_port'] == port_int -> !=.

falsifiability.mutation: if activity["remote_port"] == port_int -> if activity["remote_port"] != port_int

findings_addressed.oracle: Four independent oracles against sentinel-augmented real data: (1) presence oracle — 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1 (public IPs from file-path sentinel) and https://example.com/payload.bin (URL from registry sentinel) must be in IOC values; (2) exclusion oracle — 192.168.254.253 (private IP) must NOT be in IOC values, checked via stdlib ipaddress.ip_address().is_private not the production _is_private_ip; (3) dedup oracle — exactly one ('ipv4', '8.8.8.8') entry despite it appearing in two different FileChange paths; (4) non-empty gate — iocs must not be empty.

falsifiability.mutation_1: Delete `_add_ioc('ipv4', match.group(1), source, ctx)` from _scan_text -> 8.8.8.8 and 1.1.1.1 absent from iocs -> presence oracle fails
falsifiability.mutation_2: Delete `_add_ioc('url', match.group(1), source, ctx)` from _scan_text -> URL absent from iocs -> presence oracle fails
falsifiability.mutation_3: Remove `if ioc_type == 'ipv4' and _is_private_ip(value): return` from _add_ioc -> 192.168.254.253 appears in IOC values -> exclusion oracle fails
falsifiability.mutation_4: Remove `if key in seen: return` from _add_ioc -> duplicate ('ipv4','8.8.8.8') appears twice -> dedup oracle count > 1 fails
